cohort: The study included 6794 mother-child pairs, with 295 affected by GDM, born between 2008 and 2014 in Aarhus, Denmark.
finding: Pregnancies affected by GDM showed higher fetal growth rates from week 25 and an increased risk of overweight in the offspring at ages 5-9 years, with fetal growth rate in early third trimester mediating up to 15% of this association.
